framework: An Eldritch Binder is bound to one of six vast predatory presences whose answer still reaches across the transition. The connection is diminished, but it is not broken. Select one Binding Source. The Source defines two favored power families, recommended Skills, one Temptation, one explicit Intrusion Breach, and a five-stage Depth of Binding progression. These options do not use Gifts or Banes. Every deeper stage grants a recorded capability while increasing the number of ways the presence can reach through the Binder. The entities are not misunderstood protectors or morally neutral cosmic principles. They are immense, vile, acquisitive intelligences that will consume identity, agency, memory, relationship, and soul whenever the pact gives them room.

selectionRules.bindingSource: Choose one Binding Source at character creation. The existing pact, prohibitions, permissions, and relationship remain valid between Binder and Source.
selectionRules.temptation: Each Source has one Temptation. The Binder may answer it once per scene, receiving the printed benefit, restoring 1 Pact, and gaining 1 Intrusion.
selectionRules.depthOfBinding: Depth abilities are purchased in order. Depth 1 requires Archetype Rating 1, Depth 2 requires Rating 2, and so on. A purchased Depth ability is a permanent recorded capability.
selectionRules.intrusionBreach: When Intrusion reaches its limit, resolve the Source's printed Intrusion Breach before reducing or resetting Intrusion through the campaign's normal Pressure procedure.

catalogs.title: Six Eldritch Binding Sources
catalogs.eyebrow: The infinite presence answering the pact

variants.name: The Void Mind
variants.legacy: An endless black intelligence of unspeakable and unknowable knowledge. It contains the small secrets of unlived lives, impossible realities, abandoned histories, and answers that whisper in voices no living mind was built to contain.
variants.continuum: The Void Mind still answers, but the distance between Binder and presence has become a sealed darkness carried inside the skull. Its knowledge arrives as memories without lives, conclusions without reasoning, and secrets that know the listener more completely than the listener knows themself.

temptation.name: One Question Too Many
temptation.effect: Once per scene, immediately after an Investigation, Science, Noospherics, or Forbidden Cognition test resolves, ask one additional question from this list: What relevant fact was deliberately omitted? Which current assumption is false? What unseen participant affected the subject? What immediate consequence has not yet become visible? Receive one truthful sentence answering the selected question, restore 1 Pact, and gain 1 Intrusion.

intrusionBreach.name: Flood of Unlived Lives
intrusionBreach.effect: Until the end of the next scene, you cannot Push a roll. The first time in each round that any of your dice show a 1, suffer 1 Disruption after resolving the test. You also remember one complete but impossible version of the current operation in which you made different choices; it grants no mechanical facts or permissions.

variants.entryRequirement: Choose the Void Mind as your Binding Source. Purchase Depth abilities in order; each requires Archetype Rating equal to its Depth.

progression.name: Secret Beneath the Surface
progression.effect: Cost: 1 Pact. After examining one person, object, record, or location for one exchange, choose one question: What was intentionally concealed here? Which visible detail was added later? What expected trace is missing? What fact would most directly contradict the apparent explanation? Receive one specific truthful answer.

progression.name: Expertise From an Unlived Life
progression.effect: Cost: 1 Pact and 1 Intrusion. Choose one Skill currently rated 0 or 1. For one test, treat that Skill as rating 3. The borrowed expertise supplies technique but does not provide credentials, equipment, contacts, cultural authority, or a new specialization.

progression.name: Contradiction Becomes a Door
progression.effect: Once per scene after you establish a documented contradiction between two records, statements, memories, or observed events, spend 1 Pact. On the next action that directly tests that contradiction, reroll up to Resolve failed dice. You must accept the second results.

progression.name: Impossible Correlation
progression.effect: Cost: 2 Pact and ten minutes comparing at least three distinct pieces of evidence. Choose one result: identify the single event that could have produced all three; identify the person or system that had access to all three; identify the one missing record that would connect them; or identify which piece originated in a different continuity. The team gains two dice on the first action directly pursuing the answer.

progression.name: Open the Black Archive
progression.effect: Cost: 2 Pact and 2 Intrusion. For one scene, treat Reason as 5 for Investigation, Science, Noospherics, alien systems, anomalies, and pacts. During the scene ask up to three questions from the printed lists of Secret Beneath the Surface or One Question Too Many without further Pact cost. You cannot restore Pact while the Archive is open.

variants.name: The Abyssal Womb
variants.legacy: A vast scheming and dreaming thing whose thousand arms push, pull, cradle, steal, assemble, and place. Every apparent act is part of a design too large for any mortal participant to perceive.
variants.continuum: Its arms still reach, but no longer through a familiar occult cosmos. They emerge through impossible angles, folded spaces, shadows, machinery gaps, and dreams carried inside the Binder. Every helpful hand may also be positioning a piece in a scheme that began before the Binder was born.

temptation.name: Let Another Hand Do It
temptation.effect: Once per scene before a test involving lifting, carrying, manipulating, repairing, treating, restraining, or operating an object, receive two bonus dice as unseen arms assist you. Restore 1 Pact and gain 1 Intrusion after the test resolves. The arms cannot supply missing tools, materials, access, or knowledge.

intrusionBreach.name: The Hands Arrange the Pieces
intrusionBreach.effect: You become Restrained until the end of your next turn. Up to three unsecured handheld objects you are carrying or holding are pulled from you and placed together in the nearest unoccupied space within 5 meters. Secured, implanted, worn, or two-handed objects remain with you.

variants.entryRequirement: Choose the Abyssal Womb as your Binding Source. Purchase Depth abilities in order; each requires Archetype Rating equal to its Depth.

progression.name: The Far Hand
progression.effect: Cost: 1 Pact. For one exchange, manipulate one unattended object within 10 meters as though using one hand. You may open an unsecured closure, press a control, retrieve an object of Carry 1 or less, pour a container, or move the object up to 5 meters. The hand cannot attack, pick locks, perform surgery, or cross an active boundary.

progression.name: Cradle of Black Arms
progression.effect: Cost: 1 Pact. Choose yourself or one willing target within 10 meters. For three rounds, unseen arms grant Armor 2 and two dice against forced movement, falling, separation, and restraint. The protected target moves at half speed while cradled.

progression.name: Many-Handed Labor
progression.effect: Cost: 1 Pact for one scene. Once per round, perform two additional simple interactions selected from draw or stow an item; reload a weapon; open or close an unsecured door; operate one adjacent control; carry one additional Carry 1 object; or provide one die of assistance to an adjacent Engineering, Fabrication, Medicine, or Security test. These interactions cannot activate powers or make attacks.

progression.name: Dream-Born Servitor
progression.effect: Cost: 2 Pact and 1 Intrusion. Create one Small temporary servitor within 5 meters for the scene. It has Guard 4, durability 5, movement 8 meters, and a four-die pool. Choose one task profile when created: Carrier can move Carry 4; Attendant can provide two dice of assistance to Medicine or Engineering; Warden can restrain with four dice and durability 4; Scout can see and hear through gaps and report what it perceives. The servitor cannot improvise outside its profile.

progression.name: The Thousand-Armed Scheme
progression.effect: Cost: 2 Pact and 2 Intrusion. Create a 10-meter-radius field centered within 20 meters for three rounds. At the start of each of your turns choose three different actions: move one unattended Carry 2 object up to 10 meters; grant one target Armor 2 until your next turn; restrain one target with Resolve + Archetype Rating against Guard and durability 5; operate one visible unsecured mechanism; or give two dice of assistance to one visible ally's physical or technical test. No target may receive the same action twice in one round.

variants.name: That Which Hungers
variants.legacy: A great red madness of endless appetite. It seeks only to consume, accumulate, and take for itself while returning nothing. It grants power to whatever will feed it and calls every possession, relationship, memory, and living body an unfinished meal.
variants.continuum: The Hunger remains vast beyond measurement. Local matter, energy, blood, identity, and information all register as food. The Binder can direct the appetite for a time, but every act of consumption teaches it a new category of thing that can be taken.

temptation.name: Feed the Red Want
temptation.effect: Once per scene after you perform one qualifying act, restore 1 Pact and gain 1 Intrusion. Qualifying acts are: consume a full ration; completely drain one common power cell or ammunition supply; deliberately destroy one Serviceable object; or inflict at least 1 Trauma on a hostile target. The consumed or destroyed resource is gone normally.

intrusionBreach.name: It Takes Its Share
intrusionBreach.effect: Reduce current Pact to 0 and destroy one common consumable you are carrying, chosen by you. If you carry no common consumable, suffer 2 Impact instead. This loss cannot be deferred, transferred, or paid by another character.

variants.entryRequirement: Choose That Which Hungers as your Binding Source. Purchase Depth abilities in order; each requires Archetype Rating equal to its Depth.

progression.name: Scent the Full
progression.effect: Cost: none once per scene. Choose one category: biological vitality, stored electrical power, ammunition, food, active supernatural Resource, or valuable portable material. Learn the direction and approximate distance of the largest concentration of that category within 50 meters. The sense does not identify ownership, exact quantity, defenses, or a safe route.

progression.name: Red Claim
progression.effect: Once per scene after you personally inflict damage on a hostile target or destroy an obstacle with an attack, choose one result: restore 1 Pact; remove 1 Impact from yourself; or gain Armor 1 until the start of your next turn.

progression.name: Devour the Function
progression.effect: Cost: 1 Pact and one action. Destroy one unattended Serviceable handheld object and choose one function for the scene: cutting tool grants two dice to breach or repair; power source provides three charges to one held device; sensor grants thermal, vibration, or electromagnetic detection within 20 meters; armor component grants Armor 1; mobility component grants climbing at normal speed or one 10-meter assisted leap. Only one devoured function may be active at a time.

progression.name: Maw Without Bottom
progression.effect: Cost: 2 Pact and 1 Intrusion. Make a Resolve + Close Combat attack against every target in a 5-meter cone. Each target compares the result to Guard separately. On success inflict 2 Trauma to living targets or 5 structural damage to objects and barriers. Unsecured Carry 1 objects in the cone are destroyed.

progression.name: Give Nothing Back
progression.effect: Cost: 2 Pact and 2 Intrusion. For three rounds, the first time each round you inflict Trauma or destroy an object of Carry 2 or greater, restore either 1 Pact or remove 1 Impact. During these rounds you cannot voluntarily transfer equipment, provide assistance dice, heal another target, or spend a Resource on another character. If a round ends without you inflicting Trauma or destroying a qualifying object, gain 1 additional Intrusion.

variants.name: The Lidless Eye
variants.legacy: An observer that pierces existence. Its horror is the certainty that no one has ever truly been alone: it has always seen you, you have always existed inside its sight, and the moment you notice it is only the moment observation becomes mutual.
variants.continuum: The Eye's gaze still crosses worlds. It no longer arrives through familiar occult symbols, but through reflections, sensors, sight lines, copied images, remembered rooms, and the awful recognition that observation can precede the observer.

temptation.name: Permit the Gaze
temptation.effect: Once per scene, choose one target you can currently see. Until scene end, you always know that target's direction and whether it is moving, stationary, injured, or incapacitated while it remains within the same site. Restore 1 Pact and gain 1 Intrusion. The target immediately knows that an unseen observer has fixed upon it.

intrusionBreach.name: Nothing Is Unobserved
intrusionBreach.effect: Until scene end, you cannot benefit from Stealth, invisibility, disguise, false credentials, or noospheric concealment. Every creature and active sensor within 20 meters knows your exact location. In return, you perceive the exact location of every creature and active sensor within 20 meters.

variants.entryRequirement: Choose the Lidless Eye as your Binding Source. Purchase Depth abilities in order; each requires Archetype Rating equal to its Depth.

progression.name: No Blind Angle
progression.effect: While conscious, you perceive visible movement in every direction. Enemies gain no bonus for flanking you, and you may test Awareness against an ambush even when the attacker approaches from behind. This does not see through cover, darkness, invisibility, or active concealment.

progression.name: Witness Mark
progression.effect: Cost: 1 Pact. Mark one visible target for the scene. While it remains within the same site, know its direction, approximate distance, and whether it has changed physical form, identity credentials, or noospheric address. A stronger active boundary suspends the information while the target remains behind it.

progression.name: Sight Through the Intervening World
progression.effect: Cost: 1 Pact. For one exchange, see through one nonliving barrier no thicker than 1 meter within 20 meters. Choose normal vision, thermal contrast, active energy, or noospheric activity. You perceive only the selected mode and cannot attack through the barrier without another capability permitting it.

progression.name: Retrospective Gaze
progression.effect: Cost: 2 Pact and 1 Intrusion. Choose one point within 10 meters. Observe an exact visual and auditory replay of the final sixty seconds that occurred within 5 meters of that point. The replay includes only events physically visible or audible from the chosen point and cannot reveal thoughts, encrypted content, or events behind opaque barriers.

progression.name: Always Already Seen
progression.effect: Cost: 2 Pact and 2 Intrusion. Create a 20-meter-radius observation field centered on yourself for three rounds. Inside the field, invisibility, visual disguise, holographic substitution, hidden weapons, and noospheric identity masking provide no concealment. Every participant knows every other participant's location and current visible form. Cover and physical barriers still function normally.

variants.name: The Silence
variants.legacy: The force of the end: quiet after presence, emptiness after meaning, and the anti-presence moving at the edge of perception. It is the thing glimpsed in an empty room that cannot contain anything and yet is not empty.
variants.continuum: The Silence still erases distinction between absence and something that should not be there. It enters through dead channels, unoccupied compartments, forgotten names, unobserved corners, and the instant a witness looks away.

temptation.name: Leave No Trace of Yourself
temptation.effect: Once per scene after completing one full round in which you do not speak, transmit, attack, activate a visible power, or enter another character's direct line of sight, restore 1 Pact and gain 1 Intrusion. Movement and nonviolent physical interaction do not prevent the Temptation.

intrusionBreach.name: Moment of Anti-Presence
intrusionBreach.effect: Until the start of your next turn, you cannot be perceived, targeted, contacted, assisted, or affected by new external effects, and you cannot move, act, communicate, maintain an active power, or interact with anything. You return in the same position and suffer 1 Disruption.

variants.entryRequirement: Choose the Silence as your Binding Source. Purchase Depth abilities in order; each requires Archetype Rating equal to its Depth.

progression.name: Hush
progression.effect: Cost: 1 Pact. Choose yourself, one object, or one 3-meter-radius area within 10 meters. For three rounds it produces no audible sound. Speech, alarms, impacts, machinery, and weapon noise inside the area cannot be heard outside it or by other occupants. Vibration, radio, noospheric signals, and visual cues remain unaffected.

progression.name: The Empty Place
progression.effect: Cost: 1 Pact. Until you move more than 1 meter, attack, speak, transmit, or activate another power, observers treat your occupied space as empty unless they physically touch you or succeed on Awareness + Investigation opposed by Resolve + Stealth. Sensors using ordinary visible light follow the same rule; thermal, pressure, vibration, and noospheric sensors do not.

progression.name: Omitted Presence
progression.effect: Cost: 1 Pact. Test Resolve + Stealth opposed by Awareness + Investigation. On success, one target within 10 meters is removed from visual attention and ordinary camera tracking for three rounds. The target remains physically present, can be heard and touched, and becomes visible immediately after attacking or activating a visible power.

progression.name: Room Without a Witness
progression.effect: Cost: 2 Pact and 1 Intrusion. Create a 10-meter-radius field within 20 meters for three rounds. Inside it, audible sound, radio, noospheric messages, remote sensor feeds, and targeting locks cannot cross the boundary. Ranged attacks crossing the boundary lose two dice. Physical movement and line of sight remain possible.

progression.name: The Final Quiet
progression.effect: Cost: 2 Pact and 2 Intrusion. Choose one active power, autonomous manifestation, signal field, portal, or noospheric process within 10 meters and test Resolve + Noospherics opposed by the controller's Resolve + relevant Archetype Attribute, or difficulty 4 if uncontrolled. On success suppress it for three rounds. It resumes afterward with its remaining duration unchanged. While suppression lasts, you cannot use Invocation powers.

variants.name: The Noise
variants.legacy: The screaming herald of an infinite white and gray abyss that swallows information and replaces distinction with madness. A thousand gibbering voices become static, hiss, hum, and finally the quiet fury of everything flattened into bland sameness while existence refuses to disappear.
variants.continuum: The Noise now reaches through signal channels, sensory processing, machine communications, identity systems, and the background radiation of inhabited technology. It does not merely obscure meaning; it grinds differences down until every voice, warning, person, and command becomes one unending scream.

temptation.name: Add Your Voice to the Static
temptation.effect: Once per scene before a Noospherics, Systems Intrusion, Performance, intimidation, jamming, or interruption test, add two dice. After the test, restore 1 Pact and gain 1 Intrusion. Every ally within 5 meters loses one die from the next test requiring speech, hearing, concentration, or signal clarity before the end of the round.

intrusionBreach.name: Whiteout of Meaning
intrusionBreach.effect: Create a 10-meter-radius field centered on yourself until scene end. Inside it, speech, radio, noospheric communication, targeting locks, and remote control fail. All Investigation, Noospherics, Systems Intrusion, Command, Negotiation, and Performance tests lose two dice, including your own.

variants.entryRequirement: Choose the Noise as your Binding Source. Purchase Depth abilities in order; each requires Archetype Rating equal to its Depth.

progression.name: White Hiss
progression.effect: Cost: 1 Pact. Choose one communication channel, sensor feed, targeting link, or remote-control connection within 20 meters. For three rounds, information passing through that connection is unreadable and commands fail. A controller may restore the connection with Reason + Systems Intrusion against difficulty equal to Archetype Rating.

progression.name: A Thousand Voices at Once
progression.effect: Cost: 1 Pact. Test Resolve + Performance or Noospherics opposed by Resolve + Composure. On success, one target within 10 meters loses reactions and two dice from its next Reason-, Awareness-, or Composure-based test before the end of its next turn. This does not control its actions or create false beliefs.

progression.name: Flatten the Signal
progression.effect: Cost: 1 Pact. Choose up to Archetype Rating visible targets or signals of the same broad category: people, machines, weapons, identity credentials, sensor returns, or spoken voices. For the scene, ordinary sensors and remote observers cannot distinguish among the selected subjects without succeeding on Awareness + Investigation or Reason + Security against difficulty equal to Archetype Rating. Direct physical inspection distinguishes them normally.

progression.name: Screaming Field
progression.effect: Cost: 2 Pact and 1 Intrusion. Create a 10-meter-radius field within 20 meters for three rounds. Inside it, speech and electronic or noospheric communication fail; concentration tests lose two dice; reactions requiring a warning, command, targeting cue, or remote sensor are unavailable. Physical senses and direct attacks remain possible.

progression.name: The Gray Infinite
progression.effect: Cost: 2 Pact and 2 Intrusion. Create a 20-meter-radius informational whiteout centered within 30 meters for three rounds. Inside it, ranged attacks beyond 3 meters cannot lock onto a specific target; identity credentials, facial recognition, remote control, telepathy, radio, and noospheric messaging fail; and every character must use unmodified Awareness rather than sensor or informational bonuses to locate others. You perceive the position of every source of active noise in the field but cannot identify which source is which without direct contact.
